prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1186; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. Complaints centered on neck pain, stiffness, and restricted range of motion, with headaches radiating from the base of the skull. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of impact, and the presenting symptoms fit that pattern closely. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury diagnosed as cervical strain. No prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding musculature is known from the patient's history or records. Care was delivered over 22 visits, including manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program. Treatment followed a typical course, with visit frequency tapering as the patient's range of motion and pain improved. Billed services correspond to the documented visits, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. The patient has been discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
